title: Core: AS2 ternary operator (? :)
description: Test compilation of ternary/conditional expressions: x > 0 ? 'positive' : 'negative', nested ternary: a ? b ? 1 : 2 : 3, ternary with function calls: cond ? fn1() : fn2(), ternary in assignment: var x = flag ? trueVal : falseVal. Verify bytecode contains conditional jump opcodes (ActionIf 0x9D or ActionJump 0x99).
